```bash

### 📊 Comparison for Year 2023: Nalanda vs. Gaya

Source Workbook: [`nutrition_review_side_by_side.xlsx`](file:///workspace/nutrition_review_side_by_side.xlsx) • Sheet: `Quarterly Review`

---

### 1. Nutrition Screening Coverage (%) in 2023
*Source: Table 1 (Range `Quarterly Review!A1:C7`), Year 2023 is in **Column C***

| Block | Source Cell | 2023 Screening Coverage | Difference (Nalanda vs Gaya) | Relative Difference |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Gaya** | `C5` | **`68%`** | Baseline | — |
| **Nalanda** | `C6` | **`76%`** | **`+8.0%` points higher** | **`+11.76%` higher** |

> **Calculation:**
> - **Absolute Difference**: $76\% - 68\% = \mathbf{+8.0\text{ percentage points}}$
> - **Relative Percentage**: $\frac{76 - 68}{68} \times 100\% = \mathbf{+11.76\%}$

---

### 2. Completed Anaemia Referrals (Children) in 2023
*Source: Table 2 (Range `Quarterly Review!E1:G7`), Year 2023 is in **Column G***

| Block | Source Cell | 2023 Referrals Completed | Difference (Nalanda vs Gaya) | Relative Difference |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **Gaya** | `G5` | **`150` children** | Baseline | — |
| **Nalanda** | `G6` | **`160` children** | **`+10` more referrals** | **`+6.67%` higher** |

> **Calculation:**
> - **Absolute Difference**: $160 - 150 = \mathbf{+10\text{ children / referrals}}$
> - **Relative Percentage**: $\frac{160 - 150}{150} \times 100\% = \mathbf{+6.67\%}$

---

Indicator                     Gaya (2023)    Nalanda (2023)    How Much Higher (Nalanda)

Completed Anaemia Referrals   150 (Cell G5)  160 (Cell G6)     +10 children (+6.7%)
========================================================================================
```
